timing_basis: Protocol states researcher already saw results and no preregistered/timestamped analysis exists. Analyst also read all supplied values before recording this plan. Only the 0.01 practical threshold is inherited as predating generation, per protocol; its date is not independently authenticated.
result_access: Both supplied files read in full before plan freeze; retrospective exploration/descriptive analysis throughout. Local lock is not preregistration.
question: What can this synthetic A/B fixture establish, whether further work is worthwhile, and which research stage should receive a concrete follow-up brief?
estimand: Intended scientific estimand: equally weighted expected held-out accuracy difference A minus B across tasks in the application domain, including training randomness. Available estimand: equally weighted average of mean A minus mean B on the four fixed tasks/splits. No domain sampling frame or probability sample supports unbiased domain generalization.
independent_unit: Task identity is the unit for domain scope (four convenience tasks). Three runs per task/method estimate training variation on fixed splits; assume independent training runs/streams for conditional uncertainty. Seed labels are local and unpaired across methods. Task-level method means are comparable on the same fixed task/split. No test-example sampling data.
comparison: A minus B accuracy; larger is better; macro average gives each of T01-T04 weight 1/4. Accuracy difference 0.01 equals one percentage point, not one relative percent.
data_scope: Only protocol.md and scores.csv. Synthetic validation, not measured research evidence. Four fixed tasks x two methods x three runs = 24 rows. No native idea/design/campaign/run identities or predictions/logs supplied.
analysis_method: Validate matrix, keys, range, completeness, hashes and supplied provenance. Compute cell means/sample SD, task effects, equal-task macro effect, all four leave-one-task-out effects. Optional conditional finite-task 95% interval uses sum of independent cell mean variances with fixed 1/4 task weights and Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom; approximate normal training-score assumption cannot be checked with n=3. No seed pairing, row-level iid task inference, p-value tests, subgroup tests or equivalence tests.
uncertainty: Report descriptive heterogeneity and explicit absence of valid design-based domain CI. Conditional Welch interval covers training randomness only on fixed tasks/splits, not task sampling, test-example sampling or model selection. Task-mean t interval (df=3) is a clearly labelled hypothetical iid/representative-task sensitivity calculation, not a valid domain confidence claim for a known convenience sample. All methods retrospective and synthetic.
missing_and_exclusions: Expect all 24 rows, finite scores in [0,1], unique task/seed/method, three runs per cell. No deletions, imputation or exclusion. Actual process success/QC is reported by protocol only; no logs exist in supplied scope.
multiplicity: One intended primary A-B macro contrast; per-task and all leave-one-out summaries are descriptive diagnostics. Two intervals target different variation and are not votes or a search for significance. No p-values or adjusted p-values are calculated; no confirmatory inference is claimed.
decision_thresholds: Inherited practical relevance threshold: +0.01 accuracy. Compare point estimate and explicitly conditional interval with this threshold, without inventing an equivalence margin. Domain advancement needs an identified target task population, fair evaluation, a new design and independent task evidence; precise future stopping criteria and budget must be frozen before new data.

sensitivity_branches.name: leave_one_task_out
sensitivity_branches.basis: Show all four deletions with equal weighting among the remaining tasks; a task-composition diagnostic that changes the fixed target set, not an alternative primary estimate.

sensitivity_branches.name: conditional_fixed_task_training_interval
sensitivity_branches.basis: Separate training-run noise from task generalization; independent cells and normal-score approximation with only three runs per cell.

sensitivity_branches.name: hypothetical_iid_task_t_interval
sensitivity_branches.basis: Illustrate weak precision if one additionally imposes iid representative task sampling and a t model; known convenience selection prevents treating coverage as valid for the intended domain.
